newsitem.title: USA: M.A. Hanna names McGregor chairman.
newsitem.headline: M.A. Hanna names McGregor chairman.

text.p: The M.A. Hanna Co said Wednesday that Douglas McGregor was elected chairman of the board of diretors, effective July, 1 following today's annual shareholders meeting.
McGregor, 55, became president and chief executive in January, and joined M.A. Hanna as senior vice president of operations in 1988, coming from Rockwell International Corp Inc.
The company said McGregor will succeed Martin Walker, who will retire June 30.

Hanna also said that it has approved a realignment of the company's top management structure, creating a senior leadership committee that will assume greater responsibility for global planning and management.
The company also declared its regular quarterly dividend of $0.105 per share, payable June 12 to shareholders of record, May 23.
M.A. Hannah is producer of specialty chemicals, focusing on plastic and rubber compounding, color and additive concentrates, and the distribution of plastic resins and engineered plastic shapes.
